title: Ground state energy A^{(Z-1)+}
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the ground state energy as -E_R Z^2.

title: Ground state energy A^{(Z-2)+}
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the ground state energy as -2E_R (Z - 1/4)^2.

title: Energy minimization step
description: Important: Student must minimize total energy with respect to r_0 for each ion to find optimal 1/r_0.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Student must set the photon energy ħω equal to E(A^{(Z-1)+}) - E(A^{(Z-2)+}).

title: Correct Z and element
description: Essential: Student must solve the quadratic equation to find Z=4 and identify the element as Beryllium (Be).

title: Potential energy for two electrons
description: Important: For A^{(Z-2)+}, student must include both electron-nucleus terms (-2Zq^2/r_0) and the electron-electron repulsion (+q^2/(2r_0)).

title: Kinetic energy approximation
description: Optional: Student correctly applies the given momentum-distance approximation (p^2 r^2 ≈ ħ^2) for kinetic energy terms.

title: Sign error in energy difference
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly sets ΔE = E(A^{(Z-2)+}) - E(A^{(Z-1)+}) (wrong sign), leading to an incorrect equation for Z.

title: Mis-handling electron-electron term
description: Pitfall: Student omits or uses an incorrect factor (e.g., q^2/r_0 instead of q^2/(2r_0)) for the average electron-electron repulsion energy.

title: Unit or constant misuse
description: Pitfall: Student confuses angular frequency ω with frequency f, or mis-substitutes the given values for ħ, E_R, or ω.
